title: Standard Library Imports
snippet: Import from the BPL standard library
description: The BPL standard library provides essential utilities organized into modules. Import with 'import [items] from "std/module.bpl"'. Key modules include: std/string (String manipulation), std/math (Math utilities), std/rand (random numbers), std/stats (statistics), std/date (date/time), std/env (environment variables), std/uuid (UUID generation), std/base64 and std/hex (encoding). Using stdlib modules makes code more idiomatic and maintainable than relying solely on extern C functions. This example shows importing and using several standard library utilities.
